blocks.text: A firewall is a security device or software. It controls incoming and outgoing network traffic. Firewalls block harmful or unwanted data (as shown in Figure 1.17). They act as a barrier between safe and unsafe networks. Firewalls protect computers from attacks. They are used in homes and offices.

blocks.alt: A fire on the left sends red arrows that stop at a brick wall carrying a blue shield with a green tick; green arrows go on from the wall to a computer on the right.
